rules: Commands affecting one desktop must run sequentially, including screenshots taken after actions.
ok reports command execution; assert data.exists, data.conditionMet or an application postcondition separately.
verified is null when verification was not requested; successful input delivery does not prove the expected result.
Selectors are case-insensitive literal/wildcard matches by default. -Regex accepts regular expressions, not wildcard syntax.
TimeoutMs bounds retries; an individual UI Automation provider call may exceed it.
Use -Flag=value for values starting with a dash. Negative numeric values also work as separate tokens.

VisibleControls is the default and forbids hotkey (including dialog Enter) and Shortcut clearing. AllowShortcuts requires user/testcase authorization and per-action FallbackReason/FallbackEvidence; clipboard is unsupported.
Commands use a bounded desktop mutex. DesktopBusy means not dispatched; outcome unknown requires observing the postcondition before retry.
Invalid bounds are returned as null with boundsStatus/propertyErrors; do not infer missing UIA support from missing geometry.

help.notes: Read command guidance without a desktop session or state mutation.

state.notes: Clear resets CLI context, not application state.

start.notes: FilePath/Path and positional launch target are also accepted. KillExisting is destructive and must only be used for disposable test-owned apps. Check data.windowFound. A file-association launch does not exercise an application's Open UI. Only executable launches are accepted. RequireNewProcess rejects an already-running app and returns ownedProcessId for scoped cleanup.

observe.notes: Use for unknown UI states. Prefer targeted select/read for known postconditions.

select.notes: Queries elements; it does not select a dropdown item. data.count=0 is a valid query result. Open a dropdown before looking for its items. Discover role before imposing a guessed ControlType; use ProcessId and ModalOnly for scoped dialog queries.

click.usage: click <selector options> [-Method Auto|Mouse|Invoke] [-Center true] [-Button Left|Right] [-Focus false] [-ElementFocus false] [-OffsetX 0] [-OffsetY 0] [-VerifyDisappeared]
click.notes: Auto tries UIA patterns then mouse. Mouse uses the selected control's live geometry. Invoke requires InvokePattern. Methods are explicit; do not retry a possibly completed action without observing its result.

click-coordinate.notes: Fallback only; retain a screenshot and explain the missing selector route.

type.notes: Sends literal Unicode keyboard events, including text that resembles hotkey syntax. No clipboard. PreDelete defaults to UIA TextPattern selection plus Backspace; Shortcut explicitly uses Ctrl+A and must be permitted. Verify reads ValuePattern/TextPattern and never retypes on failure. UseWildcardForVerify means literal substring containment, not a wildcard expression. MaxAttempts controls read-only verification polls. Requires confirmed focus in a writable control owned by the working application. Newlines/tabs are limited to Document controls. Shortcut clearing is blocked under VisibleControls.

hotkey.notes: Disabled by default, including Enter confirmations. One chord only, no grouped sequences or clipboard shortcuts. Requires user/testcase permission.

drag.notes: Absolute coordinates; record fallback rationale and evidence.

wait-element.notes: Assert data.exists, not just ok. Use the selector's TimeoutMs.

wait-file.notes: Assert data.conditionMet. StableMs requires unchanged length AND last-write time. Directories are not files. Stability alone does not prove file validity or content. Use unique execution paths to avoid stale-file passes.

read.notes: Returns data.text from ValuePattern, TextPattern, or element name. Choose a meaningful expected-result assertion for the target.

screenshot.notes: Evidence capture alone is not an assertion that the image is correct.

close-window.notes: With no selector, targets only the working window. An explicit selector miss never closes another working window. data.closed counts accepted close requests; inspect remaining windows for cleanup verification.

report.notes: Records a report event; it does not validate that the status is justified.

globalOptions.FallbackReason: Required explanation for every authorized shortcut
globalOptions.FallbackEvidence: Required observation/screenshot reference for every authorized shortcut
